decisions.statement: A spawned child has the environment its parent started with unless the spawn states `env`.

directives.name: Bounded Wait
directives.act: Give every wait a ceiling, and fail at that ceiling with the reason the wait was for.
directives.warrant: An unbounded wait emits nothing, neither finished nor failed, so nothing alerts and nothing retries.
aids: Bound the whole wait, not each attempt.
Never go on past the ceiling without the result.

directives.name: Split First
directives.act: Split an authored file too big to read in one answer before you change it, never around it.
directives.warrant: A write needs a body read, and no read returns this one, so the two refusals point at each other.
aids: The split is derived, not authored.
A part still too big to read is not split.

directives.name: No Code Comments
directives.act: Write a code comment only in one of the code comment forms; delete every other one.
directives.warrant: Opus 5 obeys a comment as readily as a domain, so a drifted one competes with what the domains say.
aids: Delete what it said rather than rehome it.
Add it to a domain later, only where needed.

directives.name: Real Path
directives.act: Resolve a filesystem path to its real location where the path is made.
directives.warrant: Two spellings of a path open the same file, so nothing fails until a comparison quietly answers no.
aids: Where nothing is there yet, resolve the parent.
